# Wilson Legal Group P.C.

> > Dallas-Fort Worth business law and litigation firm specializing in corporate transactions, contract disputes, and intellectual property protection for Texas companies.

Wilson Legal Group P.C. is a Dallas-based law firm providing comprehensive business law and litigation services across Texas, with particular expertise in M&A, corporate formation, contract law, and IP disputes. The firm serves clients throughout the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex and maintains practice in multiple Texas federal districts.
